home.statement: I build small, focused apps and games for Android — the kind that do one thing properly and stay out of your way. Everything here is designed, written and shipped solo.

listkeeper.description: Most list apps grow until they need a tutorial. ListKeeper goes the other way: a fast, clean place to keep your lists, with nothing bolted on that you'll never open. Make a list, check things off, get on with your day.

whataretheodds.tagline: Beat the odds. Climb the ladder.
whataretheodds.description: Start at 1 in 10. Guess the number and 1 in 20 unlocks. Keep going and the ladder runs all the way to 1 in 10,000 — then to Custom odds, where you pick your own impossible number. Most attempts fail. That's the game.
features: Eleven tiers from 1 in 10 to Custom odds
Attempts refill over time, even while closed

pixelwrangler.tagline: Tap fast. Draft a build. Climb the storm.
pixelwrangler.description: An arcade roguelike about wrangling pixels out of a destabilised feed before it overwhelms you. One fifty-wave climb, ten telegraphed boss fights, and a card drafted after every wave — stack three of a signal and a Resonance changes the rules rather than the numbers. Take the corrupted card for more power and a permanent fault, or play it clean. Every death pays out shards for a perk tree that makes the next run visibly stronger. Plays offline, no account.
features: One 50-wave climb, with checkpoints every 10 waves
10 named bosses, each with a single opening to find
A 17-perk tree funded by every run, win or lose
Plays offline — no account, no timers

shots.boss: Every fifth wave is a boss with one gap in its armour.
shots.draft: Draft one of three cards after every wave.
shots.storm: Tap to capture before the feed overwhelms you.
shots.corrupted: Corrupted cards hit harder and cost you something permanent.
shots.runover: Every run pays out shards, even the short ones.
shots.menu: The hub: your wallet, your best wave, and one button.
